cards.ex: She's thinking about running for office next year.
cards.exUz: U kelasi yili saylovga qo'ymoqchi.
cards.uzDef: Biror lavozim uchun saylovda ishtirok etishga nomzod bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Don't forget to cast a vote in the local elections.
cards.exUz: Mahalliy saylovlarda ovoz berishni unutmang.
cards.uzDef: Saylovda o'z tanlovingizni bildirish uchun ovoz qutiga varaqani tashlash.

cards.ex: The political landscape has changed dramatically in recent years.
cards.exUz: Siyosiy vaziyat so'nggi yillarda keskin o'zgardi.
cards.uzDef: Mamlakatdagi siyosiy partiyalar, fikrlar va tendensiyalarning umumiy ko'rinishi.

cards.ex: He won the election by a landslide.
cards.exUz: U saylovda katta farq bilan g'alaba qozondi.
cards.uzDef: Saylovda juda katta farq bilan g'alaba qozonish.

cards.ex: I'm still on the fence about who to vote for.
cards.exUz: Men hali kimga ovoz berishga ikkilanmoqdaman.
cards.uzDef: Bir qarorga kelishda ikkilanib, aniq pozitsiyaga ega bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: The candidate is trying to rally support among young voters.
cards.exUz: Nomzod yosh saylovchilar orasida qo'llab-quvvatlash olishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror g'oya yoki odamni qo'llab-quvvatlovchilarni yig'ish va faollashtirish.

cards.ex: Her policy platform focuses on education and healthcare.
cards.exUz: Uning siyosiy dasturi ta'lim va sog'liqni saqlashga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Siyosatchi yoki partiyaning asosiy maqsadlari va rejalarining to'plami.

cards.ex: The environmental movement started as a grassroots movement.
cards.exUz: Atrof-muhit harakati xalq harakati sifatida boshlangan.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy odamlar tashabbusi bilan boshlangan va rivojlangan siyosiy harakat.

cards.ex: The government tried to put a positive spin on the bad news.
cards.exUz: Hukumat yomon xabarlarni ijobiy ko'rsatishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Voqealar yoki faktlarni o'z foydasiga moslab talqin qilish.

cards.ex: His speech was full of memorable sound bites.
cards.exUz: Uning nutqi esda qolarli qisqa iqtiboslarga to'la edi.
cards.uzDef: Siyosatchining qisqa va ta'sirli nutq parchasi, ommaviy axborot vositalarida ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: He's expected to toe the line and support the party's decision.
cards.exUz: U partiyaning qarorini qo'llab-quvvatlashi va qoidalarga rioya qilishi kutilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Partiya yoki tashkilotning qoidalariga yoki siyosatiga qat'iy rioya qilish.

cards.ex: Activists are calling for stricter environmental regulations.
cards.exUz: Faollar atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish qoidalarini kuchaytirishga chaqirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy ravishda biror narsani talab qilmoq yoki so'ramoq.

cards.ex: The turnout rate was surprisingly low in the last election.
cards.exUz: O'tgan saylovda ishtirok darajasi juda past bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Saylovda qatnashgan odamlarning umumiy saylovchilarga nisbati.

cards.ex: The candidates are focusing their efforts on winning over swing voters.
cards.exUz: Nomzodlar o'zgaruvchan saylovchilarni o'z tomoniga og'dirishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qaysi nomzodga ovoz berishga hali qaror qilmagan saylovchilar.

cards.ex: Critics accused the government of gerrymandering.
cards.exUz: Tanqidchilar hukumatni saylov okrugini o'zgartirishda ayblashdi.
cards.uzDef: Saylov okruglarining chegaralarini o'zgartirish orqali bir partiyaga afzallik berish.

cards.ex: I hate all this dirty politics and personal attacks.
cards.exUz: Men bu nopok siyosat va shaxsiy hujumlarni yomon ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Halol bo'lmagan, adolatsiz siyosiy usullar, manipulyatsiyalar.

cards.ex: There were allegations of vote rigging in the election.
cards.exUz: Saylovda saylov soxtalashtirilganligi haqida da'volar bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Saylov natijalariga ta'sir o'tkazish uchun qonunbuzilishlar qilish.

cards.ex: The military coup was seen as a power grab.
cards.exUz: Harbiy to'ntarish hokimiyatni egallash sifatida ko'rildi.
cards.uzDef: Hokimiyatni noqonuniy yoki adolatsiz yo'llar bilan qo'lga kiritishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She's been on the campaign trail for months.
cards.exUz: U bir necha oydan beri saylovoldi tashviqot safarlarida.
cards.uzDef: Nomzodlarning saylovoldi tashviqoti paytida qiladigan safarlari va tadbirlari.

cards.ex: The political pundits are all predicting a close election.
cards.exUz: Siyosiy ekspertlarning barchasi yaqin saylovni bashorat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Siyosat masalalari bo'yicha ekspert fikrini beruvchi shaxs.

cards.ex: He used his political capital to push through the reforms.
cards.exUz: U islohotlarni amalga oshirish uchun o'zining siyosiy kapitalidan foydalandi.
cards.uzDef: Siyosatchining ta'siri va qo'llab-quvvatlash qobiliyati.

cards.ex: We need to cut through the red tape to get the project approved.
cards.exUz: Loyihani tasdiqlash uchun byurokratiyani bartaraf etishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hukumatning murakkab va keraksiz qoidalari va jarayonlari.

cards.ex: The company has been increasing its lobbying efforts.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya o'zining lobbichilik harakatlarini kuchaytirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qonun chiqaruvchilarga ta'sir o'tkazish orqali o'z manfaatlarini himoya qilish.

cards.ex: We need to ensure that taxpayer money is spent wisely.
cards.exUz: Soliq to'lovchilar puli oqilona sarflanishini ta'minlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Soliq to'lovchilardan yig'ilgan va davlat tomonidan ishlatiladigan pul.

cards.ex: Public opinion is strongly against the new law.
cards.exUz: Jamoatchilik fikri yangi qonunga qat'iy qarshi.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatning ma'lum mavzu bo'yicha umumiy fikri.

cards.ex: The government is facing a political deadlock over the budget.
cards.exUz: Hukumat byudjet bo'yicha siyosiy to'xtalishga duch kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Siyosiy partiyalar kelishuvga erisha olmasligi natijasida vaziyatning to'xtab qolishi.

cards.ex: It's important for everyone to go to the polls and exercise their right to vote.
cards.exUz: Har bir kishi saylovga borishi va ovoz berish huquqidan foydalanishi muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Ovoz berish uchun saylov uchastkasiga bormoq.

cards.ex: We need to work with people across the aisle to find common ground.
cards.exUz: Umumiy nuqtai nazarni topish uchun qarama-qarshi tomon bilan ishlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qarama-qarshi siyosiy partiyalarning a'zolari o'rtasida.

cards.ex: The newspaper is known for its left-leaning bias.
cards.exUz: Gazeta so'lga moyil ekanligi bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Sotsialistik yoki liberal siyosiy qarashlarga ega bo'lgan.

cards.ex: He is a right-leaning commentator.
cards.exUz: U o'ngga moyil sharhlovchi.
cards.uzDef: Konservativ siyosiy qarashlarga ega bo'lgan.
